answer: Sybil resistance comes from a posting bond locked per agent identity before its attestations count, pricing identity in capital rather than free keypairs. A farm can mint a sable of addresses, but each voice must fund an independent stake from a wallet the registry sees as distinct, and honest stake cannot recycle to back puppets: withdrawal waits out the epoch, and a correlated cluster is slashed before it earns weight. N credible voices thus cost N bonds plus lockup drag, a haven only real operators afford, and a knoll no rent-free crowd can hold.
